verdict.rationale: Dover documents in-product AI features that produce insights and suggestions from candidate data: applicants get an AI-powered score from 0 to 100 so you can review the strongest first, the interview page offers AI-suggested questions based on the candidate's background, and the AI Notetaker fills in interview feedback forms. These are candidate-level features only; the evidence shows no AI-generated insights across broader data such as pipeline or reporting analytics. missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions over aggregate and analytics data, a general in-product AI assistant for querying your data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Each applicant gets a score from 0 to 100, so you can review your strongest candidates first.
Click **View AI suggested questions** to see questions based on the candidate's background.
Dover AI Notetaker joins your interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills in your interview feedback form with notes.
